consumers.role: production: LibraryService builds ImageSessionStore and runs recover_running()
test harness: store handed to MediaService

routes.GET /api/image-sessions: 200 [{id,title,created,updated,attempt_count,running,cover}] sorted by updated desc; corrupt files {id,corrupt:true} last; [] when the directory is missing
routes.POST /api/image-sessions: body empty or {}; any key -> 400 {error:'不认识的字段：[...]'}; 200 full session {id,title:'新会话',title_auto:true,created,updated,attempts:[]}
routes.GET /api/image-sessions/{id}: 200 full session, done attempts carry output_missing (response only); 404 {error:'会话不存在：<id>'}; corrupt -> 400 {error:'会话文件已损坏，无法读取'}
routes.PATCH /api/image-sessions/{id}: {title} only; other keys -> 400; title stripped 1-80 chars else 400 {error:'标题须为 1–80 个字'}; 200 full session with title_auto:false; 404
routes.DELETE /api/image-sessions/{id}: 200 {deleted:id}; 404; allowed while an attempt is running; removes only <id>.json
routes.POST /api/media/image: adds session_id (required): not a string -> 400 {error:{code:'session_required',message:'请先选择或新建一个会话',detail:{}}}; unknown -> 404 {error:{code:'session_not_found',message:'这个会话已被删除，请选择或新建一个会话',detail:{}}}; seed optional (omitted/null -> secrets.randbelow(2**32)); 200 job_status snapshot plus session_id and attempt_id
routes.GET /api/media/job: job_status always carries session_id and attempt_id (null for video/music and for an image job whose session vanished before it attached)

downstream_contract.history_entry: image entries gain top-level session_id and attempt_id (null when not attached)
downstream_contract.harness: launch_test_harness(tmp_path, model_states={'qwen-image': 'present', ...}, image_runtime=True, media_script=MediaScript([...])) runs image jobs with the fake executor writing a 96x64 gradient PNG; relaunching on the same tmp_path keeps the data root (simulated restart). TestHarness.close() still does not call media.close().

quality_questions.shutdown_mid_job: MediaService.close() now joins the worker thread, so the attempt is settled cancelled_on_quit before shutdown returns (test_close_settles_attempt_cancelled_on_quit_before_returning); a killed process leaves running attempts that LibraryService startup settles failed/interrupted (test_library_startup_recovers_running_attempts, production wiring test).
quality_questions.concurrent_writes: every write reads, modifies and atomically rewrites the file under one lock with no in-memory copy (test_concurrent_settle_and_rename_lose_no_writes, test_concurrent_appends_from_two_writers_all_land).
quality_questions.delete_isolation: delete unlinks only <id>.json; /api/outputs, /api/history, the outputs directory listing and history.jsonl bytes are identical before and after (test_delete_removes_only_the_session_file, harness wiring test, real-api probe).
quality_questions.path_traversal: ids must match ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ before any path is built; traversal ids get 404 / False and a file outside the directory is untouched (test_ids_outside_the_hex_pattern_never_reach_the_filesystem).
